title: 第74章 咱家买房子了
content_zh:
第74章 咱家买房子了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林国强心里动了一下。

急卖。

急卖就意味着好谈价。

“周大爷，这房子您打算卖多少钱？”

周老头抬头看了看自家的房子，嘴唇哆嗦了半天。

“三千五。”

三千五。

三间临街门面，加后院三间瓦房，加一个大院子。

这个价，不贵。

但林国强没有立刻答应。

“周大爷，我能进去看看吗？”

“看吧。”

林国强从里到外看了一遍。

房子有些旧了，墙皮剥落，屋顶的瓦片也有碎的。

但梁柱结实，地基牢固。

修缮一下，刷遍白墙，换上新瓦，就是一座好房子。

他心里有数了。

“周大爷，三千五，我买了。”

周老头抬起头，浑浊的眼睛里闪过一丝亮光：“真的？”

“真的。”林国强说，“不过我有个条件。”

“你说。”

“今天签合同，我付五百块定金，剩下的三千，三天之内付清。

您把房契给我，咱们去房管所过户。”

周老头烟杆子都掉了：“三天？”

“对，三天。”

周老头愣了好一会儿，然后猛地站起来，抓着林国强的手：“成！成！今天就签！”

他等不及了。

老伴躺在县医院，等着钱救命。

多等一天，就多一分危险。

当天晚上，林国强找了刘强当见证人，跟周老头签了合同。

按了手印，交了定金。

房契暂时押在刘强那里，等尾款付清了再过户。

周老头攥着那五百块定金，手抖得厉害，眼眶都红了。

“林老板，你救了我老伴的命。”

林国强拍拍他手背：“周大爷，您别这么说。

您卖我买，公平买卖，尾款三天内一定送到。”

周老头连连点头，抹着眼泪走了。

刘强看着林国强，神色复杂。

“你这动作够快的，马德福下午找你，你晚上就买房了。”

“不是因为他。”林国强说，“早晚得买了他不过是推了我一把。”

刘强点点头，又看了看合同。

“这房子不错，三千五，不贵。”

“周大爷急用钱，我也没狠压价。”

刘强看了他一眼：“你这个人，做生意有底线，难得。”

林国强回到家的时候，天已经黑透了。

赵素梅坐在院子里等他，林静和林薇都睡了。

Lin Guoqiang's heart moved.

Urgent sale.

Selling urgently means negotiating a good price.

"Uncle Zhou, how much do you plan to sell this house for?"

Old man Zhou looked up at his house, his lips trembling for a long time.

"Three thousand and five."

Three thousand and five.

There are three facades facing the street, three tile-roofed houses in the backyard, and a large yard.

This price is not expensive.

But Lin Guoqiang did not agree immediately.

"Uncle Zhou, can I go in and have a look?"

"Let's see."

Lin Guoqiang looked at it from the inside out.

The house is a bit old, with peeling walls and broken roof tiles.

But the beams and columns are strong and the foundation is solid.

After some repairs, whitewashing the walls, and new tiles, it would be a good house.

He knew it well.

"Uncle Zhou, three thousand five hundred, I bought it."

Old man Zhou raised his head, a glimmer of light flashed in his cloudy eyes: "Really?"

"Really." Lin Guoqiang said, "But I have a condition."

"You said."

"Today when I sign the contract, I will pay a deposit of 500 yuan, and the remaining 3,000 yuan will be paid within three days.

Give me the deed of the house and we'll go to the housing management office to transfer it."

Old Zhou dropped his cigarette stick: "Three days?"

"Yes, three days."

Old man Zhou was stunned for a while, then stood up suddenly and grabbed Lin Guoqiang's hand: "Yes! Yes! Sign today!"

He couldn't wait any longer.

My wife is lying in the county hospital, waiting for money to save her life.

The more you wait, the more danger you will face.

That night, Lin Guoqiang found Liu Qiang as a witness and signed a contract with Old Man Zhou.

I took my fingerprints and paid the deposit.

The deed of the house is temporarily deposited with Liu Qiang and will be transferred after the balance is paid.

Old man Zhou clutched the 500 yuan deposit, his hands were shaking violently and his eyes were red.

"Boss Lin, you saved my wife's life."

Lin Guoqiang patted the back of his hand: "Uncle Zhou, don't say that.

You sell and I buy, it’s a fair trade and the balance will be delivered within three days."

Old man Zhou nodded repeatedly, wiped his tears and left.

Liu Qiang looked at Lin Guoqiang with a complicated expression.

"You act fast enough. Madford will come to you in the afternoon and you will buy a house in the evening."

"It's not because of him." Lin Guoqiang said, "Sooner or later I have to buy it. He just pushed me."

Liu Qiang nodded and looked at the contract again.

"This house is nice, 3,500 yuan, not expensive."

"Uncle Zhou is in urgent need of money, so I didn't lower the price too hard."

Liu Qiang glanced at him: "You are a person who has a bottom line in business, which is rare."

When Lin Guoqiang returned home, it was already dark.

Zhao Sumei sat in the yard waiting for him, while Lin Jing and Lin Wei fell asleep.
